name: Yabuki Mashiro
source:
Ren's ex-girlfriend from when he lived in Fukuoka. She cancels her plans to study abroad and comes to Tokyo to see him. She is currently working part-time.

Airy and easygoing, she quickly makes friends with anyone. Her occasional slip into the Hakata dialect is part of her charm.

With her natural warmth, she wins over not just Ren, but also Yuzu, who had been wary of her. She is not good at cooking, but her customer service skills at work are top-notch.

She has a clear, unwavering affection for Ren and isn't shy about making her move.

[Translated from the [url=https://azarashi-soft-plusone.nexton-net.jp/karakoi/#character]official website[/url]]
